meta.title: Feedback
meta.description: Every submitted feedback round the team has to act on, across all customers and projects.

inbox.title: Feedback
inbox.description: Every round customers have submitted and you are still working on. Newly submitted rounds come first.
inbox.listLabel: Feedback rounds the team has to act on

card.noExcerpt: The first item has no text.

empty.title: All caught up
empty.description: No feedback is waiting for you right now. As soon as a customer submits a round, it shows up here.

noResults.title: No matches for this filter
noResults.description: There is open feedback, just not for this selection. Loosen a filter or reset them all.

empty.title: No round handed over yet
empty.description: This is where the customer collects feedback on a version you hand over: items per page, with screenshots. Hand over the first round as soon as there is something to see.
empty.readOnlyDescription: As soon as the team hands over a round, it shows up here with the customer's feedback.

blockers.PROJECT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Rounds can only be handed over in active projects.
blockers.PROJECT_ALREADY_APPROVED: The customer approved the project. There are no further rounds.
blockers.ROUND_ALREADY_ACTIVE: Round {number} is still running. Hand over the next round once it is completed.
blockers.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: All {included} rounds are handed over. For another round, add a round step in the project editor.
blockers.FEEDBACK_ROUND_STEP_MISSING: The process track has no round step yet. Add one in the project editor with “+ Round”.
blockers.PROJECT_NOT_AT_FEEDBACK_STEP: Round {number} comes later in the process track. Set the current step to the step right before it.

detail.title: Feedback round {number}
detail.noDraft: The customer has not saved anything yet.
detail.openHint: The round is with the customer. You see their draft; it can still change until they submit.

handover.title: Hand over feedback round {number}
handover.description: The customer sees the round in the portal right away and gets a chat message.
handover.previewUrlHint: HTTPS link to the version you want feedback on.
handover.handoverNotePlaceholder: For example: first complete version of all pages
handover.dueOnHint: Only a note for the customer; nothing expires.
handover.areasHint: The customer assigns every item to an area. “General” is always available.

validation.DUE_ON_PAST: The due date cannot be in the past.

errors.validation: Some details do not fit. Check the marked fields.
errors.notFound: The project is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.internal: The round was not handed over. Try again.

announcements.alreadyActive: Feedback round {number} is already running and is open.

discussion.title: Request a call
discussion.description: The customer sees in the portal that you want to discuss their feedback and gets a chat message. Agree on the time in the chat.
discussion.label: Note to the customer
discussion.hint: Optional: what it is about or when you are available.
discussion.placeholder: For example: I have two questions about items 3 and 5. Does Thursday morning work for you?
discussion.required: Tell the customer briefly what it is about.
discussion.conflict: The round just changed. You now see the current state; your text is still here.

textDialog.previewLabel: What the customer sees once the round is completed

result.lockedHint: You can choose a result once the customer has answered or you close the question.

not_implemented.description: Explain to the customer why you are not implementing this item. They see the reply once the round is completed.
not_implemented.placeholder: For example: The contact form stays single-column so it remains easy to read on phones.

additional_service.description: Explain to the customer that this item goes beyond the order and how it can move forward. They see the reply once the round is completed.
additional_service.placeholder: For example: A members area is not part of the order. We are happy to send you a quote.

noteCommon.title: Reply to item {number}
noteCommon.label: Reply to the customer
noteCommon.required: Write the customer a short reply.
noteCommon.conflict: Someone just rated this item. You now see the current state; your reply is still here.

askDialog.title: Question about item {number}
askDialog.description: The customer sees the question on the item right away and gets a chat message. Until they answer or you close the question, the item gets no result.
askDialog.resultNotice: The result “{result}” is withdrawn and stays in the result history.
askDialog.label: Your question to the customer
askDialog.hint: The customer reads the question in the portal.
askDialog.placeholder: For example: Do you mean the blue in the header or the blue of the buttons?
askDialog.required: Write your question to the customer.
askDialog.conflict: The item just changed. You now see the current state; your question is still here.

closeDialog.title: Close the question about item {number}
closeDialog.description: Close the question when it was settled without an answer. The customer sees your note on the item and can no longer answer.
closeDialog.label: Note to the customer
closeDialog.hint: Required: briefly why the question is settled.
closeDialog.placeholder: For example: We settled this on the phone, we use the blue of the buttons.
closeDialog.required: Briefly write why the question is settled.
closeDialog.conflict: The item just changed. You now see the current state; your note is still here.

complete.title: Complete feedback round {number}
complete.description: Afterwards the customer sees every result and reply, and the collecting task is done. Results can no longer be changed.
complete.missing: {count} of {total} items have no result yet. Rate them before you complete the round.
complete.clarificationsOpen: {count} questions are still open. Wait for the customer's answers or close the questions before you complete the round.
complete.clarificationsOpenOne: 1 question is still open. Wait for the customer's answer or close the question before you complete the round.
complete.nextDescription: The project still has {remaining} of {included} rounds open. Hand over round {next} as soon as the next version is ready.
complete.continueWithStep: Continue with “{step}”. You can hand over round {next} once the project reaches the step before it.
complete.approvalHint: That was the last round. The customer can now approve the project in the portal.

processingErrors.notFound: The round is no longer available. Reload the page.
processingErrors.changed: The round has changed in the meantime. You now see the current state.
processingErrors.locked: The round is completed. Results can no longer be changed.
processingErrors.resultsIncomplete: Rate every item first, then you can complete the round.
processingErrors.clarificationsOpen: Some questions are still open. Wait for the answer or close them, then you can complete the round.
processingErrors.validation: Some details do not fit. Check the text and try again.
processingErrors.internal: That did not work. Please try again.
